wiki.title: Bud Williams
wiki.extract: Bud L. Williams (born 1947 or 1948) is an American politician who serves as a state representative for the 11th Hampden District in the Massachusetts House of Representatives. He represents the city of Springfield. Williams serves as the Vice Chair of the House Committee on Redistricting, and on the House Committee on Ways and Means, the Joint Committee on Economic Development and Emerging Technologies, the Joint Committee on Education, and the Joint Committee on Ways and Means.
